authorization_decision_schema.design_equality_rule: design_commit_sha1, design_tree_sha1, design_consistency_sha256, pure_core_api_v6_sha256, pure_core_api_amendment_v7_sha256, and source_authorization_amendment_v7_sha256 equal the corresponding values in every review receipt; unequal values are INVALID

literal_values.rationale: Three distinct orchestrator-assigned reviewer principals returned exact-design GO receipts, authorizing writing one pure mathematical source file only; all import, compilation, test, wrapper, child, seed, and experiment actions remain locked.

authorization_decision_schema.review_receipts_rule: Exact array of three review_receipt_reference objects in role order theory, accounting, red_team; each path and SHA-256 resolves to the byte-identical retained receipt

source_authorization_amendment.principal_identity_rule: reviewer_principal_id is the exact opaque lowercase UUID-shaped agent_id assigned by the multi-agent orchestration tool when that reviewer was spawned; it is copied, not chosen by the reviewer; the three values must be byte-distinct

rules: id and path are the exact values for role
role is exactly theory, accounting, or red_team
all design identity and digest fields equal the exact immutable review target
findings is the exact empty JSON array

source_authorization_amendment.scope_replacement: This V7 transition supersedes V6 authorization-record semantics and the five-path V5 proposal. The singleton source scope and all locks are unchanged.
source_constraints: Only the singleton authorized path may be created or modified.
Source text must conform to pure-core-api-v6.md as amended by pure-core-api-amendment-v7.md.
Writing does not authorize importing, parsing through Python, compiling, testing, executing, or auditing the source.
After writing, a new commit, source hash, and exact-source theory/accounting/red-team review are required before any import or execution action.
maximum_runs remains zero and registered seed access remains false.
source_authorization_amendment.transition_rule: Review GO is advisory. Only a later Coordinator decision conforming byte-for-byte to authorization_decision_schema changes pure_core_source_authorized to true.
